## As knitr header

Would be written like this is old document

```{sql, connection = con}
SELECT manufacturer, displ, cty
FROM mpg
ORDER BY manufacturer, displ DESC
```

## As chunk header

New way to write this option

```{sql}
#| connection: con
SELECT manufacturer, displ, cty
FROM mpg
ORDER BY manufacturer, displ DESC
```
